issues: The content is otherwise supported: the signs are presented as promises, not as occurring events, and both dialogue excerpts are verbatim. The label “Jesus Christ (at Bountiful)” is not established by these verses; speaker identity is unspecified here. The accompanying note not to identify the speaker conflicts with that label.
The source does not state who wrote this passage; the summary's attribution to “The writers” is an inference. Keep the speaker unnamed.

The summary says Moroni "offers a closing prayer," but the passage gives no explicit indication that Moroni is the speaker of the prayer; verse 37 says "may the Lord Jesus Christ grant" without identifying a speaker.
